image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a hammerhead shark swimming in dark blue water. The shark is oriented diagonally, with its head pointing towards the upper left. The distinctive cephalofoil (hammer-shaped head) is clearly visible, showing the eye at the lateral tip and the nostril area on the underside. The body is streamlined with visible gill slits and pectoral fins. Other sharks are blurred in the background.
